figs.name: point-to-point-connection-vs-multidrop-wiring-diagram
figs.alt: point to point connection vs multidrop connection wiring with dedicated and shared lines
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing point to point wiring, with one dedicated cable per device, against multidrop wiring, where addressed devices share one line.
figs.after_h2: The Definition of a Point to Point Connection

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

figs.name: point-to-point-connection-multidrop-addressing-flowchart
figs.alt: multidrop connection flowchart of broadcast packet and address check by each device
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing multidrop communication: the sender broadcasts, every device receives and checks the address, and only the matching device accepts the data.
figs.after_h2: The Definition of MultiPoint (Multidrop) Connection Communication
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>How a multidrop network delivers a broadcast packet by address</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Multidrop: How a Packet Finds Its Device</text>
<rect x="220" y="58" width="360" height="70" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="87.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sender broadcasts</text>
<text x="400.0" y="111.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the data packet</text>
<line x1="400" y1="128" x2="400" y2="150" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="220" y="152" width="360" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="181.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Every device on</text>
<text x="400.0" y="205.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the line receives it</text>
<line x1="400" y1="222" x2="400" y2="244" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="220" y="246" width="360" height="70" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="275.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Each device reads</text>
<text x="400.0" y="299.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the destination address</text>
<line x1="400" y1="316" x2="400" y2="338" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,334.0 580.0,386 400,438.0 220.0,386" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="381.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Address matches</text>
<text x="400" y="404.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">its own?</text>
<polyline points="220,386 130,386 130,460" fill="none" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="170" y="374" font-size="18" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<polyline points="580,386 670,386 670,460" fill="none" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="630" y="374" font-size="18" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="20" y="464" width="240" height="92" rx="10" fill="#15803d" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="140.0" y="492.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Accept</text>
<text x="140.0" y="516.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and process</text>
<text x="140.0" y="540.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the data</text>
<rect x="540" y="464" width="240" height="92" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="660.0" y="504.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ignore</text>
<text x="660.0" y="528.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the packet</text>
</svg>

figs.name: point-to-point-connection-vs-multipoint-comparison-infographic
figs.alt: point to point communication vs multipoint communication comparison of bandwidth, cabling and security
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing point to point and multipoint links by number of devices, bandwidth, addressing, cabling and security.
figs.after_h2: Point to Point Communication vs Multipoint Communication
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Point to point vs multipoint communication comparison infographic</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Point to Point vs Multipoint at a Glance</text>
<rect x="250" y="58" width="260" height="46" rx="8" fill="#15803d"/>
<text x="380" y="89" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Point to point</text>
<rect x="520" y="58" width="260" height="46" rx="8" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="650" y="89" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Multipoint</text>
<rect x="20" y="114" width="760" height="62" rx="8" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#bbf7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="32" y="152" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Devices on link</text>
<text x="380" y="152" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Two only</text>
<text x="650" y="152" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Many on one line</text>
<rect x="20" y="184" width="760" height="62" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#bbf7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="32" y="222" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Transmitter and receiver</text>
<text x="380" y="222" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">One to one</text>
<text x="650" y="222" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">One to many</text>
<rect x="20" y="254" width="760" height="62" rx="8" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#bbf7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="32" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Bandwidth</text>
<text x="380" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Reserved for the pair</text>
<text x="650" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Shared by all</text>
<rect x="20" y="324" width="760" height="62" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#bbf7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="32" y="362" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Addressing</text>
<text x="380" y="362" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Not needed</text>
<text x="650" y="362" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Each device checks</text>
<rect x="20" y="394" width="760" height="62" rx="8" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#bbf7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="32" y="432" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Cabling</text>
<text x="380" y="432" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">One cable per device</text>
<text x="650" y="432" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Less cable, one trunk</text>
<rect x="20" y="464" width="760" height="62" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#bbf7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="32" y="502" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Security</text>
<text x="380" y="502" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Better, not shared</text>
<text x="650" y="502" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Lower, shared channel</text>
</svg>
